name: putt-pals
description: Putt Pals desktop browser mini-golf game

scripts.rooms:dev: npm run build && wrangler dev --local --ip 127.0.0.1 --port 8787 --var ROOM_LOCAL_DIAGNOSTICS:true
scripts.check: node --check tools.js && node --check tests/solver-baseline.cjs && node tools.js check
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run test:contracts && npm run test:simulation && npm run test:session && npm run test:network && npm run test:audio && npm run test:render && npm run test:input && npm run test:ui && npm run test:app && npm run test:courses && npm run test:cli && npm run test:physics && npm run test:integration && npm run test:smoke && npm run test:multiplayer
scripts.test:contracts: node tests/contracts.test.cjs && node tests/server-room-contracts.test.cjs && node tests/gameplay.test.cjs
scripts.test:simulation: node tests/simulation.test.cjs && node tests/cup-capture.test.cjs && node tests/selfutility.test.cjs
scripts.test:physics: node tools.js surfaces && node tools.js cups && node tools.js mechanics
